dedupe_keys.name: gis dataset for climate adaptation territorial profiles and territorial planning units in nuova pescara

description: Maria Simonetta Bernabei and colleagues at Università di Camerino publish integrated territorial profiles for the CRESCO Adria pilot in Pescara, Montesilvano and Spoltore. The GIS product combines hazard, exposure and territorial-change indicators into a composite risk index, analyses local spatial clusters, and assigns adaptation profiles to grid cells and contiguous planning units. Local Climate Zones, soil sealing, building density and spatial entropy inform the classification. Zenodo lists a ZIP archive released in July 2026, free under CC BY 4.0. Grid-cell dimensions, input observation periods and internal vector formats remain unknown from the metadata. These profiles can inform spatial scenarios for urban adaptation simulations, but the authors state that interpretation depends on the other harmonised layers in the project series. No directly related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
